records.event: Anzu Robotics will continue to be identified as a gray zone entity due to its reliance on DJI hardware, firmware, and SDK.
records.evidence_basis: Teardowns confirm Anzu Robotics PCB layouts align exactly with DJI Mavic 3, controller RRC01 is a relabeled DJI RC Pro with identical firmware, and camera modules match. Firmware is signed and encrypted with DJI cryptographic keys, built on DJI SDK, and includes SecNeo/BangCle Chinese security framework. Anzu Robotics has also been flagged for banned components such as DJI p1 ocu, DJI ocusync, DJI dji sdk, SecNeo/BangCle secneo, and SecNeo/BangCle bangcle. The product was discontinued due to adversary component shortage.
records.impact: Continued classification as a gray zone entity will likely impact Anzu Robotics' ability to secure contracts with US federal agencies and other organizations subject to NDAA restrictions.
records.comparison_basis: same question and criteria; shared evidence

records.event: SkyRover / Knowact will continue to be identified as a gray zone entity due to its reliance on DJI technology and infrastructure.
records.evidence_basis: SkyRover / Knowact is identified as licensing technology from DJI (undisclosed). The SkyRover app connects directly to DJI cloud infrastructure, uses identical encryption keys found by Jon Sawyer, and allows users to log in with existing DJI credentials. Its OTA update pipeline touches adversary infrastructure. Banned components detected include DJI dji cloud, and data is hosted in China (DJI cloud). Manufacturing is also in China.
records.impact: Continued classification as a gray zone entity will likely impact SkyRover / Knowact's market access in regions with restrictions on Chinese-sourced technology and data hosting.
records.comparison_basis: same question and criteria; shared evidence

records.event: Cogito Tech / SPECTA will continue to be identified as a gray zone entity due to its reliance on DJI hardware and presumed manufacturing in an adversary nation.
records.evidence_basis: Cogito Tech / SPECTA is identified as licensing technology from DJI (undisclosed). records.impact: Continued classification as a gray zone entity will likely impact Cogito Tech / SPECTA's market access, particularly in defense and government sectors.
records.comparison_basis: same question and criteria; shared evidence

records.event: The integration of AI-enabled software, sensor fusion, and command-and-control (C2) is becoming a standard for advanced counter-drone architectures.
records.evidence_basis: DroneShield is expanding its open counter-drone architecture to include AIM Defence’s Fractl high-power laser effector, adding to RF sensing, electronic warfare and command-and-control layers. Through the collaboration, DroneShield’s DroneSentry operational platform will be interoperable with AIM Defence’s Fractl to enable operators to coordinate RF sensing, AI-enabled software, sensor fusion, command-and-control and directed energy from a common operating environment.
assumptions: DroneShield's approach is indicative of a broader trend in counter-drone system development.
records.impact: Increased demand for AI, C2, and sensor fusion technologies in the counter-UAS market, driving innovation and integration efforts.
drivers: Advancements in AI and sensor technology
records.comparison_basis: same question and criteria; shared evidence

records.event: The U.S. Army is testing autonomous machine gun systems for counter-drone applications.
records.evidence_basis: An autonomous machine gun system engaged drone targets in the Arizona desert, according to official photos from a U.S. military exercise. The system, called Bullfrog and built by Texas startup Allen Control Systems, pairs a standard M240 machine gun with a robotic turret, in this case bolted into the bed of a pickup truck.
records.impact: Potential for new acquisition programs focused on autonomous ground-based counter-UAS systems, creating opportunities for companies developing robotic weapon platforms and AI-driven targeting solutions.
records.comparison_basis: same question and criteria; shared evidence
